When we provide our services, we have a need to process personal data. We typically process the following personal data when you use our products and services.\nWe may collect the following type of personal information:

We may update this Privacy Statement according to changes in our business functions and measures concerning the protection of personal information. If we make changes to this Privacy Statement, we will notify you. Where changes to this Privacy Statement will have a fundamental impact on the nature of the processing or otherwise have a substantial impact on you, we will give you sufficient advance notice so that you have the opportunity to exercise any rights you have.\n\nSpecial Note: If you tick \"I agree to the Privacy Statement \", you will be deemed to have fully read, understood and agreed to this Statement and voluntarily accepted all the contents. If you do not agree with this Statement, the Browser and associated services cannot provide for you.
We will collect gears, system version, location information (through your active authorization), clipboard information, you\'re aforementioned vehicle information will be processed in-vehicle.
We will record your browsing history, forms as you use your browser, your browsing history will be processed in-vehicle.
Log information generated during the operation of the browser. Including device name, device model, and authorized permission information.
We may record your password for logging in to a third-party website using your browser (through your active authorization) and your login password will be processed in-vehicle.

Cookies are a common technology used in the Internet. We promise that we will not use cookies for any purpose other than those described in this Privacy Policy. We use cookies primarily to ensure the safe and efficient operation of our products and/or services, to enable us to confirm the security status of your account and transactions, to detect anomalies related to crashes and delays, and to help save you the steps and processes of filling out forms and entering search content repeatedly, your cookies data will be processed in-vehicle.

To ensure the security of your property and the security of the vehicle system, we will analyse the security of the URL address in the cloud and block the insecure URL. Please note that we do not collect your personal data via URLs.
We use personal data to manage and meet service and information requests, to understand vehicle website use, and to make our products and services as effective as possible.

Please note that it is unable to identify a specific natural person just with information of individual equipment and operating system, etc. To optimize products, we may analyse non-personal information. If we combine such non-personal information with other non-personal information or personal information to identify a specific natural person, then the non-personal information will be regarded as personal information. Unless authorized by you or required by the law and regulation, we will anonymize your personal information.
We do not sell your personal data to anyone for any purpose, period. The table below illustrates who we may share your personal data with:

When third parties are given access to your personal data, we will take the required contractual, technical and organizational measures to ensure that your personal data are only processed to the extent that such processing is necessary. In other cases, your personal data will not be supplied to third parties, except where required or allowed by law.\nBrowser is not currently using any third-party services. However, since the browser is developed on the basic framework foundation of Chromium,the open-source project, for data about the open source components of Chromium, please take care to check Google\'s privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy;

We will store your personal data within your residential country/district or other specific storage locations mentioned in contact detail, We will take appropriate measures to ensure that safeguards are in place to ensure adequate data protection level, complies with laws on the transfer of personal data between countries to help ensure your personal data is protected as described in this Statement and ensures that your data is adequately protected by adopting appropriate technical and organizational measures (e.g. encryption).

Unless exceptions provided by applicable law and regulations, you generally have the right to ask us:
for access to your personal data that we hold.
withdraw consent given, or deemed to have been in respect of the collection, use or disclosure.
to update or correct your personal data in order to make it accurate.
If the processing of personal data is based on the consent of the Data Subject, he or she may withdraw his or her consent at any time, but this does not affect the lawfulness of the previous processing.
Disabling location: If you no longer want browser to collect your location information, or your address information, please disable them in the "Vehicle settings - system settings - Application management - Permissions - Locationin" or disable them in the Browser's "Setting - Site settings - location".
Delete browsing history: if you no longer want browser to record your browsing history, please delete them in the Browser's "Setting - Privacy and Security - Clear browsing data".
Delete Cookies: if you no longer want browser to record your cookies, please delete them in the Browser's "Setting - Privacy and Security - Clear browsing data".

These rights may be limited in some situations – for example, where we can demonstrate that we have a legal requirement to process your data or if making the information available to you would reveal personal data about another person or if we are legally prevented from disclosing such information. In some instances, this may mean that we are able to retain data even if you withdraw your consent.
We hope that we can satisfy any queries you may have about the way we process your data. If you have any concerns about how we process your data, you can contact us as described below in the section "If you have any questions about your data".
In the event you still have unresolved concerns, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in particular the data protection authority in the Member State of your habitual residence or place of work.
Finally, please note that where we require personal data to comply with legal or contractual obligations, then provision of such data is mandatory: if such data is not provided, then we will not be able to manage our contractual relationship, or to meet obligations placed on us. In all other cases, provision of requested personal data is optional.

For data about your using of the Browser, we will keep your information for the duration of any contractual relationship you have with us, and, to the extent permitted, after the end of that relationship for as long as necessary to perform the purposes set out in this Statement. We retain the information we collect from or about you for the period necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Statement unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. When the information is no longer necessary for these purposes, we delete it or keep it in a form that does not identify you. When determining this retention period, we take into account various criteria, including the type of services requested by or provided to you, the nature of our relationship with you, the impact on the services we provide to you if we delete some information from or about you, and retention periods required by law.

We strive to maintain the appropriate standards of security and Browser has put in place robust technical and organizational measures for the protection of your data in accordance with the current, general state of technology, especially to protect the data against loss, falsification, or access by unauthorized third persons. However, the transmission of information via the internet is not completely secure. So, whilst we will do our best to protect your personal data, we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your data transmitted via BYD vehicle or Browser to access third party interfaces. Any transmission is at your own risk. Once we have received your personal data we will use strict procedures and security features to prevent unauthorized access. In the unfortunate event that a personal data security incident occurs, we will report it promptly and take remedial measures in accordance with the requirements of the law and regulatory authorities.

We endeavour to protect children\'s personal data. The provision of our connected vehicle products and/or services are only for adults, and we will not intentionally collect any personal data from children. In the events when the personal data of the children is collected with the consent of their parents or guardians, we will only use or disclose this data when permitted by law, with the explicit consent of the parents or guardians, or when necessary to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the children. If we discover that we have collected personal data from a child without first obtaining the consent of parents or guardians, we will seek to delete the data as soon as possible. If a parent or guardian discovers that we have collected a child\'s personal data without the parents or guardians\' consent, please notify us immediately through the contact data listed above, and we will try to delete the relevant data as soon as possible, except as required by applicable law.

If you have any questions about the processing of your personal data, please read this Privacy Statement first and the Privacy Statement of BYD vehicle system. For additional questions, please feel free to contact us through our e-mail or write to us via contact details mentioned above according to your residence. Please note that we take your satisfaction very seriously. Should you have a complaint, please also direct it to the same email address and we will respond to you as soon as we can. You can of course also lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of the country in which you live.
